label: caiso per hub intertie
definition: CAISO keeper (structurally-faithful successor to caiso-import-cap-floor): byte-identical config, the ONLY change is the measured WECC intertie parquet now carries the FULL delivered nodal LMP (energy+congestion+loss = MCE+MCC+MCL, GHG excluded) per scheduling point instead of the byte-identical system MCE — so MALIN (PNW/Mid-C) and PALOVRDE (desert-SW) finally differ (2024 MALIN mean 40.1/313 neg-hrs vs PALOVRDE 33.3/949 neg-hrs). The import injector drops the modeled multiplicative line-loss markup (the measured MCL now carries the real loss) and keeps only the OATT wheel (rules #11/#12). Effect: 2024 mean LMP 42->39.24 toward actual 35.8 (the DIAGNOSIS-caiso-body-overprice midday-floor target improves); 2024 neg-hours 815->873 (actual ~800); 2024 net interchange -30.4->-35.95 TWh (actual -32.4) and 2025 -38.6->-44.18 (actual -36.2) — over-import GREW because the now-cheaper desert-SW PALOVRDE hub pulls more midday import volume; diurnal phase corr still negative (2024 -0.34). 2023 falls back to the static ladder (OASIS Jan-Feb aged out -> incomplete 8760, unchanged from keeper). Residual / next root cause: the over-import is a discovered downstream issue (import cap / DSW gas coupling), NOT a reason to revert the faithful measured input.
